name: sim-i
description: Edit RPG in your repo, have each save compiled on Sim i, and debug it there: breakpoints, stepping, variables, watches.

program.description: The program to call: MYLIB/MYPGM or MYPGM. Left out, it's the program of the source file that's open.

parms.description: The parameters, as CALL passes them: text as characters, numbers as packed (15 5).

stopOnEntry.description: Stop at the program's first statement.

terminal.description: Run the program in your 5250 session that waits at a command line (true), or in a job of its own with DSPLY in the debug console (false). Left out, a program with a display file runs in the session.

host.description: Sim i's host (default: the simI.host setting).

port.description: Its debug port (default: the simI.debugPort setting).

user.description: The user profile to sign on with (default: the simI.user setting).

sourceRoot.description: The folder laid out LIBRARY/FILE/member.ext (default: the simI.sourceRoot setting, or the workspace folder).

jobUser.description: Whose jobs stop at breakpoints: a user profile, or *ALL. Left out, the user signed on with: run the program in that user's 5250 session.

host.description: Sim i's host (default: the simI.host setting).

port.description: Its debug port (default: the simI.debugPort setting).

user.description: The user profile to sign on with (default: the simI.user setting).

sourceRoot.description: The folder laid out LIBRARY/FILE/member.ext (default: the simI.sourceRoot setting, or the workspace folder).

initialConfigurations.name: Sim i: attach to my 5250 session

configurationSnippets.label: Sim i: attach to a user's jobs

simI.host.description: Sim i's host name or address.

simI.webPort.description: Its web port (--web-port), which saved source is sent to.

simI.user.description: The user profile to sign on with. The password is asked for once and kept in VS Code's secret storage.

simI.sourceRoot.description: The folder laid out LIBRARY/FILE/member.ext, when it isn't the workspace folder: an absolute path, or one relative to the workspace folder.

simI.uploadOnSave.description: Send each source file to Sim i when it's saved: it's checked and compiled there, and what's found is listed under Problems.

simI.remoteHost.description: The real IBM i that a program's files are copied from: its host name or address.

simI.remoteUser.description: The user profile to sign on to the real IBM i with. The password is asked for once and kept in VS Code's secret storage.

simI.remoteLibraries.description: The libraries on the real IBM i to look for a program's files in, in order.

simI.siteUrl.description: The address Sim i's site has in the browser (https://sim-i.example.com), for opening the terminal, the profiles and Receive from here, and the terminal when a program with screens is debugged.
